headline: Dynatrace Q1 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Dynatrace (NYSE:DT) said its first-quarter fiscal 2027 results exceeded the high end of its guidance, supported by record new-logo growth, expanding platform consumption and continued demand for observability tools as enterprises deploy more artificial intelligence workloads.
